import json
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(r"C:\Users\carys\.cursor\plans\nd_cts_narrowed_packs.json")
data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
patterns = ["1.2", "1.3", "1.7", "3.7"]
packs = data.get("packs", {})
hot_prefixes = ("ctsmisc/", "ccd/skewopt/", "mscts/", "ctscto/")

for pid in patterns:
    items = packs.get(pid, [])
    print(f"=== {pid}: {len(items)} candidates ===")
    hot = [it for it in items if it.get("file", "").replace("\\", "/").startswith(hot_prefixes)]
    print(f"  hot files: {len(hot)}")
    for it in hot[:20]:
        snip = (it.get("snippet") or "")[:100]
        print(f"  {it.get('file')}:{it.get('line')} | {snip}")
    if len(hot) > 20:
        print(f"  ... and {len(hot)-20} more hot")
    print()
